title: Two Men Talking Under Foliage, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot taken in February 1966 capturing an outdoor conversation between two men beneath the dappled shade of a leafy tree. On the left, an older man in a light-colored overcoat and thick-rimmed glasses speaks to a younger man on the right, who wears a tailored dark suit, narrow necktie, and glasses. In the sunlit background, other formally dressed attendees mingle, suggesting a civic gathering, reception, or formal event characteristic of mid-1960s professional and community life.
